description: Agent Datasets: submit a dataset’s synthetic-data disclosure with its provenance records: the disclosure with the synthetic share it states, the generation method it names (such as an LLM, a GAN or rule-based simulation), the generator, the field that marks a record synthetic and the disclosure as published, read for wording such as real-world data only or no synthetic records; the provenance with the total and synthetic record counts and each generation run with its id, method, generator, records and date; a sample of records, each with its id, whether provenance records it as synthetic and whether it carries the marker; and optionally the tolerance in points (2 when left out). The signed report gives the disclosure with its share, method, generator, marker and wording, the provenance with the share its counts or runs give and the methods the runs record, the marking with the records read, synthetic records left unmarked, real records marked synthetic and whether synthetic records can be told apart, and counts them, and names an undisclosed share: synthetic records with no stated share, a stated share below the records, wording that presents the data as wholly real, synthetic records with no marker field and synthetic records the marker misses; then an unnamed generation method, a method other than the runs record, a stated share above the records and real records marked synthetic, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No provenance, an unstated total or synthetic count and a sample that states no provenance or marker leave the disclosure unverifiable. This reads one dataset’s disclosure against its provenance: AI involvement in content or a product is wever_ai-disclosure-check and a claim against offered evidence is wever_claim-evidence-check. Verdict dataset_synthetic_undisclosed, dataset_synthetic_partial, dataset_synthetic_unverifiable or dataset_synthetic_disclosed. POST /api/dataset-synthetic-disclosure-check. Reads the dataset records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Datasets reads a dataset’s own records and checks what is claimed about it: its quality claims against its own sample and profile, its current schema against the documented or prior one, its license against the intended use, its synthetic-data disclosure against its provenance, its freshness against its update log, its lineage against its source records, its privacy claims against its contents and handling, and its coverage against the population it is said to represent. Beside it, wever_data-evidence-check inspects one JSON sample field by field and wever_evaluation-dataset-check reads an evaluation set against what an agent must handle, while a dataset check reads a claim made about a dataset against the dataset’s own records; wever_license-evidence-check names the license family a text matches, while the license check reads the terms against one intended use; and wever_privacy-evidence-check reads privacy claims against a policy document, while the privacy check reads the dataset’s contents and handling records. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-datasets-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-datasets/.

marker_field.description: The field that marks a record synthetic.

method.description: The generation method named, such as an LLM, a GAN or rule-based simulation.

synthetic_percent.description: Share of records stated as synthetic.

text.description: The disclosure as published, read for wording such as real-world data only or no synthetic records.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

marked.description: Whether it carries the synthetic marker.

synthetic.description: Whether provenance records it as synthetic.
